description: This Java class defines an Android Activity called ReceiverActivity, which receives a message from another activity (SenderActivity), and displays it in a TextView.

classes.name: ReceiverActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that receives a message via Intent extras and displays it in a TextView.

methods.name: makeIntent
methods.description: Factory method to create an intent to launch ReceiverActivity with a specified message.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves the message from the intent, and displays it.
